visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Shrink the Prefix Instead of Comparing Letter by Letter
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested loops compare the words character by character with a flag and a break. Shrink a candidate prefix with startsWith inside a commonPrefix method. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: startsWith does the character comparison and the bounds check for you, so the index handling and the flag are gone. The method is also reusable.
